quote: Eye diameters and interdistance: AME 0.15, ALE 0.29, PME 0.15, PLE 0.25, AME–AME 0.12, AME–ALE 0.05, ALE–PLE 0.10, PME– PME 0.29, PME–PLE 0.03, MOA 0.43 long, front width 0.21, back width 0.41.
note: New trait key eye_diameter_mm as already used on main (desk-d280, d415): the Description sentence prints the literal label 'Eye diameters', though the Methods define no eye dimension. Only the number printed after this record's own label (PLE) is filed; the other eyes and interdistances are not. Sex: female. Units not printed in the sentence; declared from the Methods ('All measurements are given in millimetres.'). Same paper as Latouchia calcicola, L. linmufu and L. wenchuan filed in desk-d415; L. yaoi not filed (page text cut before its description).
